articles.summary: Rebranding supports a simpler corporate structure and prioritizes defense growth ORLANDO, FL / ACCESS Newswire / November 3, 2026 / Laser Photonics Corporation (NASDAQ:LASE), an emerging laser technology company focused on developing quantum directed-energy weapons for defense applications as well as pharmaceutical, semiconductor and industrial laser technologies to modernize domestic manufacturing infrastructure supporting the U.S. military
articles.title: Laser Photonics Announces Name Change to LASE Corp.
